question: Can the already computed selected-record action laws identify either information about an unknown private physical error or an unconditional paired logical-risk difference?
role: Two-branch provenance and estimand preflight, not a new physical-error ensemble or policy evaluation

frozen_scope.geometry: J7M/J7P ideal periodic L=2 D4 vacuum orbit and private initial red-X error [0,4,3]
frozen_scope.first_record: One complete signal-only first public record of exact mass 1/4 conditional on that fixed private error
frozen_scope.public_private_boundary: Only full binary public records and relation-free declared correction are visible to an online policy; physical error, later fault, orbit and score remain private.
frozen_scope.no_transfer: J6's phenomenological five-round pilot and its risk rows are not an IID ideal-projector ensemble for J7. Its scoring and paired-unit definitions may inform a future contract, but its numerical rows cannot be pooled with J7.

matrix.test: Count distinct positive-prior private initial errors represented at the same first public record under both public actions; check for a frozen prior and complete action-conditioned law for each error.
matrix.identifiable_only_if: At least two private initial errors have positive weights under a declared prior, the same public first-record conditioning event and both complete action-conditioned public laws. A conditional mutual-information contrast must hold the prior and intervention fixed across arms.

matrix.test: Check for an explicitly frozen physical-error distribution, independent attempted-history denominator, matched physical/first-observation/second-exogenous keys, and private ground-state-relative Boolean-union score for both actions.
matrix.identifiable_only_if: Every attempted history in the declared ensemble is retained, including terminal/invalid completions as failures, and both arms are scored on the same private physical draw. A two-error conditional toy is not full-channel unconditional risk without a quantified omitted-mass bound.

outcomes.both_identified: Only if every branch-specific requirement is present in pinned artifacts; otherwise prohibit information or risk promotion.
outcomes.one_or_both_unidentified: Record exactly which input or estimand field is missing; keep the J7P/J7Q finite ideal action-effect claim unchanged and register the next prerequisite separately.
outcomes.censored: A pin or source-integrity mismatch suspends this audit; do not infer from mutable artifacts.

acceptance: Audit both registered branches on the same frozen source set
Report positive support count and missing ensemble/score fields without treating later-fault keys as alternative initial errors
Retain exact J7P/J7Q finite ideal scope and make no benefit, threshold or policy-emission claim
stop_rule: Stop after the two read-only branches. No adaptive error selection, Born expansion, history sampling, policy arm, bootstrap, budget increase or reinterpretation of J6 rows.
